description: deSEC DNS, through its API: free, with DNSSEC. Each name's A and AAAA records are written together, in one request.

token.description: A token of the account, made at desec.io under Token Management. A token restricted to the zone, or to the names ipv6ddns keeps, is enough.

zone.description: The domain at deSEC, as example.com or example.dedyn.io.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 1h. Default: the least deSEC allows the domain, an hour for most; a lower one is raised to it, with a warning.
